word: A bad workman blames his tools
meaning_hi: अकुशल व्यक्ति अपने साधनों को दोष देता है
meaning_en: an incompetent person blames external factors rather than their own lack of skill
example: He blamed the software for his poor report, but everyone knew it was a bad workman blaming his tools.

word: A friend in need is a friend indeed
meaning_hi: संकट में साथ देने वाला ही सच्चा मित्र होता है
meaning_en: a true friend helps when you are in trouble
example: When everyone else walked away, it was Suresh who stood by him — a friend in need is a friend indeed.

word: A little knowledge is a dangerous thing
meaning_hi: अधूरा ज्ञान खतरनाक होता है
meaning_en: having only partial knowledge of a subject can lead to serious mistakes
example: He attempted the electrical repair after watching one video — a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.

word: A penny saved is a penny earned
meaning_hi: बचाया हुआ पैसा कमाए हुए के बराबर है
meaning_en: saving money is as worthwhile as earning it
example: She avoided unnecessary expenses and built a substantial fund — a penny saved is a penny earned.

word: A rolling stone gathers no moss
meaning_hi: बार-बार स्थान बदलने वाला स्थिरता नहीं पाता
meaning_en: a person who constantly changes jobs or places gains little stability or wealth
example: He changed careers six times in ten years without building expertise — a rolling stone gathers no moss.

word: A stitch in time saves nine
meaning_hi: समय पर किया गया काम बड़ी परेशानी से बचाता है
meaning_en: fixing a problem early prevents it from becoming worse
example: The engineer repaired the minor crack before the monsoon; truly, a stitch in time saves nine.

word: Actions speak louder than words
meaning_hi: कर्म शब्दों से अधिक प्रभावशाली होते हैं
meaning_en: what people do matters far more than what they say
example: He never boasted but donated half his income to charity — actions speak louder than words.

word: All roads lead to Rome
meaning_hi: लक्ष्य तक पहुँचने के कई रास्ते होते हैं
meaning_en: there are many different ways to achieve the same goal
example: Whether you study alone or in a group, all roads lead to Rome if you are determined.

word: All that glitters is not gold
meaning_hi: हर चमकने वाली चीज सोना नहीं होती
meaning_en: appearances can be deceptive; things are not always what they seem
example: The startup looked impressive on paper but collapsed within a year — all that glitters is not gold.

word: An apple a day keeps the doctor away
meaning_hi: नियमित स्वस्थ आदतें बीमारी से बचाती हैं
meaning_en: healthy habits prevent illness
example: He follows a strict diet and rarely falls ill; an apple a day keeps the doctor away.

word: As you sow, so shall you reap
meaning_hi: जैसा करोगे वैसा भरोगे
meaning_en: your actions determine your results
example: He treated his employees with dignity and they remained loyal for decades — as you sow, so shall you reap.

word: Barking dogs seldom bite
meaning_hi: जो ज्यादा धमकी देते हैं वे कम नुकसान पहुँचाते हैं
meaning_en: people who threaten loudly are usually harmless
example: The supervisor made threats all day but took no action; barking dogs seldom bite.

word: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder
meaning_hi: सुंदरता देखने वाले की नज़र में होती है
meaning_en: beauty is subjective and depends on the observer
example: Critics dismissed the painting, but thousands loved it — beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

word: Beggars can't be choosers
meaning_hi: जरूरतमंद लोग अधिक चयन नहीं कर सकते
meaning_en: people with limited options cannot afford to be selective
example: Without a better offer on the table, he accepted the lower salary — beggars can't be choosers.

word: Better late than never
meaning_hi: देर आए दुरुस्त आए
meaning_en: it is better to do something late than not at all
example: He finally completed his graduation at forty — but better late than never.

word: Better safe than sorry
meaning_hi: सावधानी पछतावे से बेहतर है
meaning_en: it is wiser to be cautious than to take risks
example: The doctor recommended a second test just to be sure — better safe than sorry.

word: Birds of a feather flock together
meaning_hi: समान स्वभाव वाले लोग साथ रहते हैं
meaning_en: people with similar interests and characters tend to associate together
example: The reformers in the assembly naturally aligned with one another — birds of a feather flock together.

word: Blood is thicker than water
meaning_hi: परिवार का रिश्ता सबसे गहरा होता है
meaning_en: family bonds are stronger than any other relationship
example: Despite the quarrel, he stood by his brother in court — blood is thicker than water.

word: Boys will be boys
meaning_hi: बच्चों की शरारत स्वाभाविक है
meaning_en: males, especially young ones, will behave in ways typical of their gender
example: They broke the window while playing cricket — boys will be boys.

word: Charity begins at home
meaning_hi: भलाई की शुरुआत अपने घर से होती है
meaning_en: one's first duty is to family and those closest to you
example: Before funding foreign causes, he ensured his own community was supported — charity begins at home.

word: Cleanliness is next to godliness
meaning_hi: स्वच्छता ईश्वर के समान है
meaning_en: being clean is almost as virtuous as being holy
example: The school instils hygiene habits in children early — cleanliness is next to godliness.

word: Cross the bridge when you come to it
meaning_hi: जब समस्या आए तब उससे निपटो
meaning_en: deal with a problem when it arises rather than worrying in advance
example: He refused to worry about hypothetical setbacks — cross the bridge when you come to it.

word: Curiosity killed the cat
meaning_hi: अत्यधिक जिज्ञासा नुकसानदेह होती है
meaning_en: being too curious can lead to trouble
example: She pried into confidential files and lost her job — curiosity killed the cat.

word: Cut your coat according to your cloth
meaning_hi: आय के अनुसार खर्च करना चाहिए
meaning_en: live within your means; spend only what you can afford
example: He cancelled the luxury holiday and chose a modest one — cut your coat according to your cloth.

word: Dead men tell no tales
meaning_hi: मृत व्यक्ति राज़ नहीं बताते
meaning_en: those who are dead cannot reveal secrets
example: The witness who could identify the culprit had died — dead men tell no tales.

word: Diamond cuts diamond
meaning_hi: हीरे को हीरा ही काटता है
meaning_en: only someone equally capable or cunning can overcome another who is very able
example: The new prosecutor matched the crafty defence lawyer argument for argument — diamond cuts diamond.

word: Discretion is the better part of valour
meaning_hi: समझदारी असली वीरता है
meaning_en: it is sometimes wiser to avoid unnecessary danger than to face it recklessly
example: He chose not to confront the armed gang alone — discretion is the better part of valour.

word: Do not bite off more than you can chew
meaning_hi: अपनी क्षमता से अधिक काम मत उठाओ
meaning_en: do not take on more work or responsibility than you can handle
example: He accepted five projects simultaneously and delivered none on time — do not bite off more than you can chew.

word: Do not bite the hand that feeds you
meaning_hi: जो तुम्हारा पालन-पोषण करे उसे तकलीफ मत दो
meaning_en: do not act against the interests of those who support or help you
example: He publicly criticised the sponsor who had funded his research — he had bitten the hand that fed him.

word: Do not count your chickens before they hatch
meaning_hi: सफलता से पहले उत्साहित नहीं होना चाहिए
meaning_en: do not assume a good outcome before it is certain
example: The company began celebrating the contract before it was signed — do not count your chickens before they hatch.

word: Do not put all your eggs in one basket
meaning_hi: सारी पूँजी एक जगह मत लगाओ
meaning_en: do not risk everything on a single plan or investment
example: He diversified his portfolio across sectors — do not put all your eggs in one basket.

word: Do unto others as you would have them do unto you
meaning_hi: दूसरों के साथ वैसा व्यवहार करो जैसा तुम चाहते हो वे तुम्हारे साथ करें
meaning_en: treat others the way you want to be treated
example: She returned the wallet with all its cash — do unto others as you would have them do unto you.

word: Easier said than done
meaning_hi: कहना आसान, करना मुश्किल
meaning_en: something is much harder to do than to talk about
example: He promised to climb the peak, but reducing the deficit proved easier said than done.

word: Empty vessels make the most noise
meaning_hi: अल्पज्ञानी लोग अधिक शोर मचाते हैं
meaning_en: people with the least knowledge often talk the most
example: He had no real expertise but dominated every meeting — empty vessels make the most noise.

word: Every cloud has a silver lining
meaning_hi: हर बुरी स्थिति में कुछ अच्छा छिपा होता है
meaning_en: every difficult situation contains some element of hope
example: Losing the job pushed him to start his own firm, which became far more successful — every cloud has a silver lining.

word: Every dog has its day
meaning_hi: हर व्यक्ति का अच्छा समय आता है
meaning_en: everyone experiences at least one moment of success in life
example: After years of rejection, his novel became a bestseller — every dog has its day.

word: Every man is the architect of his own fortune
meaning_hi: हर व्यक्ति अपने भाग्य का निर्माता है
meaning_en: a person's success or failure is determined by their own efforts and choices
example: Born in poverty, he built a business empire through relentless effort — every man is the architect of his own fortune.

word: Experience is the best teacher
meaning_hi: अनुभव सबसे बड़ा शिक्षक है
meaning_en: people learn best through actual experience rather than theory
example: He made costly mistakes in his first business, but those lessons guided his second — experience is the best teacher.

word: Failure is the pillar of success
meaning_hi: असफलता सफलता की सीढ़ी है
meaning_en: failures teach lessons that pave the way to success
example: Edison failed thousands of times before inventing the bulb — failure is the pillar of success.

word: Familiarity breeds contempt
meaning_hi: अत्यधिक परिचय अनादर पैदा करता है
meaning_en: knowing someone too well may cause one to lose respect for them
example: The celebrity's constant media appearances diminished his mystique — familiarity breeds contempt.

word: First come, first served
meaning_hi: पहले आओ, पहले पाओ
meaning_en: those who arrive earliest receive priority
example: Seats were limited and distributed on a first come, first served basis.

word: First deserve, then desire
meaning_hi: पहले योग्यता अर्जित करो, फिर इच्छा रखो
meaning_en: earn the right to something before expecting to receive it
example: He spent years building expertise before applying for the senior role — first deserve, then desire.

word: Forewarned is forearmed
meaning_hi: पूर्व सूचना सुरक्षा प्रदान करती है
meaning_en: knowing about a problem in advance allows you to prepare for it
example: The intelligence report helped the army prepare its defence — forewarned is forearmed.

word: Fortune favors the brave
meaning_hi: भाग्य साहसी लोगों का साथ देता है
meaning_en: those who take bold action are more likely to succeed
example: She left a stable job to pursue her passion and built a thriving company — fortune favors the brave.

word: Give a man a fish and you feed him for a day; teach a man to fish and you feed him for a lifetime
meaning_hi: मछली दो तो एक दिन का भोजन, मछली पकड़ना सिखाओ तो जीवन भर का भोजन
meaning_en: it is better to teach someone a skill than to keep giving them help
example: The NGO focused on vocational training rather than cash handouts — give a man a fish and you feed him for a day; teach a man to fish and you feed him for a lifetime.

word: God helps those who help themselves
meaning_hi: ईश्वर उन्हीं की मदद करता है जो स्वयं प्रयास करते हैं
meaning_en: self-effort is the key to receiving help and success
example: He prepared thoroughly for months and cleared the exam — God helps those who help themselves.

word: Grasp all, lose all
meaning_hi: सब कुछ हथियाने की कोशिश में सब खो देते हैं
meaning_en: being too greedy results in losing everything
example: He tried to acquire three companies simultaneously and went bankrupt — grasp all, lose all.

word: Great minds think alike
meaning_hi: महान लोग एक जैसा सोचते हैं
meaning_en: intelligent people often arrive at the same idea independently
example: Both scientists submitted identical solutions without consulting each other — great minds think alike.

word: Half a loaf is better than none
meaning_hi: कुछ न होने से थोड़ा होना बेहतर है
meaning_en: having something, even if less than desired, is better than having nothing
example: He accepted the partial scholarship gladly — half a loaf is better than none.

word: Haste makes waste
meaning_hi: जल्दबाजी में काम बिगड़ जाता है
meaning_en: acting too quickly leads to mistakes and inefficiency
example: The rushed merger resulted in legal complications nobody had anticipated — haste makes waste.

word: He who laughs last, laughs longest
meaning_hi: अंत में हँसने वाला ही असली विजेता होता है
meaning_en: the person who achieves final success is the true winner
example: Mocked for years, she became the most decorated athlete of her era — he who laughs last, laughs longest.

word: He who lives by the sword, dies by the sword
meaning_hi: जो हिंसा से जीता है, वह हिंसा से ही मरता है
meaning_en: those who use violence will eventually be destroyed by it
example: The criminal empire he built ultimately led to his own destruction — he who lives by the sword, dies by the sword.

word: Health is wealth
meaning_hi: स्वास्थ्य ही धन है
meaning_en: good health is the most valuable possession
example: The millionaire spent his fortune treating a preventable illness — health is wealth.

word: Honesty is the best policy
meaning_hi: ईमानदारी सबसे अच्छी नीति है
meaning_en: being truthful is always the best approach in life
example: He admitted the error to his client and maintained a trusted relationship for years — honesty is the best policy.

word: Hope for the best, prepare for the worst
meaning_hi: सर्वोत्तम की आशा करो, बुरे की तैयारी भी रखो
meaning_en: remain optimistic but also be ready for bad outcomes
example: The manager kept backup plans for every stage of the project — hope for the best, prepare for the worst.

word: If it ain't broke, don't fix it
meaning_hi: जो काम कर रहा हो उसे बदलने की जरूरत नहीं
meaning_en: do not change something that is working perfectly well
example: The efficient system needed no overhaul — if it ain't broke, don't fix it.

word: If wishes were horses, beggars would ride
meaning_hi: केवल इच्छाओं से काम नहीं चलता
meaning_en: it is useless to wish for things without taking action
example: He kept dreaming of becoming an IAS officer but never opened a book — if wishes were horses, beggars would ride.

word: Ignorance is bliss
meaning_hi: अज्ञान कभी-कभी सुखद होता है
meaning_en: not knowing the full truth can sometimes prevent unnecessary anxiety
example: The child played happily, unaware of the family's financial troubles — ignorance is bliss.

word: In the country of the blind, the one-eyed man is king
meaning_hi: अंधों में काना राजा
meaning_en: even a person of limited ability appears superior among those with no ability at all
example: His basic accounting knowledge made him indispensable among the entirely untrained staff — in the country of the blind, the one-eyed man is king.

word: It is no use crying over spilt milk
meaning_hi: बीती बात पर पछताना व्यर्थ है
meaning_en: there is no point in being upset about something that cannot be changed
example: The deal was lost; there is no use crying over spilt milk — focus on the next opportunity.

word: It is the last straw that breaks the camel's back
meaning_hi: छोटी सी बात भी बर्दाश्त की सीमा पार करा देती है
meaning_en: a final small addition to an already heavy burden causes a complete breakdown
example: After months of overwork, one more demand from management was the last straw that broke the camel's back.

word: It takes two to tango
meaning_hi: झगड़े में दोनों पक्ष जिम्मेदार होते हैं
meaning_en: certain actions or problems require the involvement of two parties
example: The breakdown of negotiations was not one-sided — it takes two to tango.

word: Jack of all trades, master of none
meaning_hi: सब काम जानने वाला किसी में माहिर नहीं होता
meaning_en: a person who can do many things but is not expert in any
example: He dabbled in writing, painting and music but mastered none — jack of all trades, master of none.

word: Judge not, lest ye be judged
meaning_hi: दूसरों को मत आँको, कहीं तुम खुद न आँके जाओ
meaning_en: do not criticise others, as you yourself may be found guilty of similar failings
example: He refrained from condemning his colleague — judge not, lest ye be judged.

word: Knowledge is power
meaning_hi: ज्ञान ही शक्ति है
meaning_en: having knowledge gives one an advantage over others
example: The lawyer who studied the most obscure precedents won the most complex cases — knowledge is power.

word: Laughter is the best medicine
meaning_hi: हँसी सबसे अच्छी दवा है
meaning_en: humour and cheerfulness improve one's health and wellbeing
example: The comedian's show lifted the spirits of patients in the ward — laughter is the best medicine.

word: Let bygones be bygones
meaning_hi: पुरानी बातों को भूल जाओ
meaning_en: forget past quarrels and move forward
example: After years of dispute, the two brothers reconciled and decided to let bygones be bygones.

word: Let sleeping dogs lie
meaning_hi: सोती हुई मुसीबत को मत जगाओ
meaning_en: do not bring up old problems that have been forgotten
example: The case was closed years ago — better to let sleeping dogs lie.

word: Life is not a bed of roses
meaning_hi: जीवन हमेशा सुखद नहीं होता
meaning_en: life involves hardship and challenges
example: The young graduate soon discovered that life is not a bed of roses in the corporate world.

word: Lightning never strikes twice in the same place
meaning_hi: एक ही व्यक्ति पर एक जैसी दुर्घटना दुबारा नहीं होती
meaning_en: the same misfortune rarely happens to the same person twice
example: He was the victim of two frauds in a year, proving that lightning never strikes twice is not always true.

word: Like father, like son
meaning_hi: जैसा बाप वैसा बेटा
meaning_en: a son's character and behaviour often resembles his father's
example: Both were passionate reformers who entered public service — like father, like son.

word: Little drops of water make the mighty ocean
meaning_hi: छोटी-छोटी बूँदें मिलकर समुद्र बनाती हैं
meaning_en: small contributions accumulate into something great
example: Their small daily donations built a hospital over ten years — little drops of water make the mighty ocean.

word: Look before you leap
meaning_hi: कोई भी कदम सोच-समझकर उठाना चाहिए
meaning_en: think carefully before committing to a course of action
example: He researched every aspect of the investment before committing — look before you leap.

word: Make hay while the sun shines
meaning_hi: अवसर का सही समय पर लाभ उठाना चाहिए
meaning_en: take advantage of favourable conditions while they last
example: Farmers harvested quickly before the weather changed — make hay while the sun shines.

word: Many hands make light work
meaning_hi: मिलकर काम करने से काम आसान हो जाता है
meaning_en: sharing a task among many people makes it easier and quicker
example: The entire department pitched in and completed the report by noon — many hands make light work.

word: Might is right
meaning_hi: शक्तिशाली का हुक्म चलता है
meaning_en: those with power or strength impose their will on others
example: In the absence of fair laws, the powerful landowner evicted the tenants — might is right.

word: Money is the root of all evil
meaning_hi: धन सभी बुराइयों की जड़ है
meaning_en: excessive love of money leads to immoral behaviour
example: The embezzlement scandal proved once again that money is the root of all evil.

word: Necessity is the mother of invention
meaning_hi: आवश्यकता आविष्कार की जननी है
meaning_en: difficult situations inspire creative solutions
example: The shortage of water in the village led farmers to develop a simple drip irrigation system — necessity is the mother of invention.

word: Necessity knows no law
meaning_hi: आवश्यकता में नियमों की परवाह नहीं रहती
meaning_en: in urgent situations, people may act outside normal rules
example: He broke the curfew to reach the hospital; in such circumstances, necessity knows no law.

word: Never judge a book by its cover
meaning_hi: बाहरी दिखावे से किसी का मूल्यांकन मत करो
meaning_en: do not judge someone or something by outward appearance alone
example: The shabbily dressed man turned out to be the most gifted surgeon in the hospital — never judge a book by its cover.

word: No man is an island
meaning_hi: कोई भी अकेले नहीं रह सकता
meaning_en: everyone depends on other people; no one is truly self-sufficient
example: Even the most independent thinkers rely on the ideas of others — no man is an island.

word: No news is good news
meaning_hi: कोई खबर न आए तो सब ठीक है
meaning_en: if you have heard nothing, you may assume everything is going well
example: He had heard nothing from the interview panel for two weeks — no news is good news, he told himself.

word: No pain, no gain
meaning_hi: मेहनत के बिना सफलता नहीं मिलती
meaning_en: success requires hard work and sacrifice
example: The athlete woke at four every morning to train — no pain, no gain.

word: Nothing succeeds like success
meaning_hi: सफलता से बड़ी और कोई सफलता नहीं
meaning_en: success brings further success
example: His first bestseller opened doors to publishing contracts around the world — nothing succeeds like success.

word: Nothing ventured, nothing gained
meaning_hi: जोखिम के बिना कुछ हासिल नहीं होता
meaning_en: you cannot achieve anything without taking risks
example: He applied for the position despite being underqualified — nothing ventured, nothing gained.

word: Old is gold
meaning_hi: पुरानी चीजें अक्सर मूल्यवान होती हैं
meaning_en: older things or people are often more valuable than new ones
example: He preferred the tried-and-tested method over the untested shortcut — old is gold.

word: Once bitten, twice shy
meaning_hi: एक बार धोखा खाने के बाद व्यक्ति सावधान हो जाता है
meaning_en: a bad experience makes a person cautious in the future
example: After losing money in a scam, he verified every investment thoroughly — once bitten, twice shy.

word: One man's meat is another man's poison
meaning_hi: एक के लिए अच्छी बात दूसरे के लिए बुरी हो सकती है
meaning_en: what is good or beneficial for one person may be harmful to another
example: City life delights him but overwhelms her — one man's meat is another man's poison.

word: One swallow does not make a summer
meaning_hi: एक घटना से कोई निष्कर्ष नहीं निकाला जा सकता
meaning_en: a single encouraging event does not guarantee that good times have come
example: One positive quarter does not mean the recession is over — one swallow does not make a summer.

word: Out of sight, out of mind
meaning_hi: दूर रहने से लोग भूल जाते हैं
meaning_en: people tend to forget what or whom they cannot see
example: After moving abroad, he slowly lost touch with his school friends — out of sight, out of mind.

word: Patience is a virtue
meaning_hi: धैर्य एक गुण है
meaning_en: the ability to wait calmly is a highly admirable quality
example: She waited three years for the right opportunity — patience is a virtue.

word: Penny wise, pound foolish
meaning_hi: छोटी बचत, बड़ी हानि
meaning_en: careful about small amounts but wasteful with large sums
example: He saved on car maintenance but spent ten times more on repairs — penny wise, pound foolish.

word: People who live in glass houses should not throw stones
meaning_hi: जो खुद कमज़ोर हों वे दूसरों पर आरोप न लगाएँ
meaning_en: those with faults of their own should not criticise others
example: He criticised his colleague's tardiness while being late every day himself — people who live in glass houses should not throw stones.

word: Poverty is not a crime
meaning_hi: गरीबी कोई अपराध नहीं
meaning_en: being poor is not something to be ashamed of
example: The judge reminded the court that poverty is not a crime and that justice must be impartial.

word: Power corrupts; absolute power corrupts absolutely
meaning_hi: सत्ता भ्रष्ट करती है; असीमित सत्ता पूरी तरह भ्रष्ट करती है
meaning_en: those in authority often become corrupt, especially if unchecked
example: The dictator who began as a reformer became a tyrant — power corrupts; absolute power corrupts absolutely.

word: Practice makes a man perfect
meaning_hi: अभ्यास से व्यक्ति निपुण बनता है
meaning_en: regular practice leads to mastery
example: The pianist rehearsed the piece two hundred times before the recital — practice makes a man perfect.

word: Prevention is better than cure
meaning_hi: इलाज से बेहतर बचाव है
meaning_en: it is wiser to prevent a problem than to deal with it later
example: Health campaigns focus on lifestyle change because prevention is better than cure.

word: Quarrel not with bread and butter
meaning_hi: आजीविका से मत लड़ो
meaning_en: do not take actions that harm your own livelihood
example: He was advised not to argue with his employer unnecessarily — quarrel not with bread and butter.

word: Rome was not built in a day
meaning_hi: महान कार्यों में समय लगता है
meaning_en: important achievements require time and patience
example: The reform of the tax system took five years — Rome was not built in a day.

word: Rotten apples spoil the barrel
meaning_hi: एक सड़ा हुआ सेब पूरी टोकरी बिगाड़ देता है
meaning_en: one corrupt person can damage an entire group
example: One dishonest officer brought disrepute to the entire unit — rotten apples spoil the barrel.

word: See no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil
meaning_hi: बुरा मत देखो, बुरा मत सुनो, बुरा मत बोलो
meaning_en: choose not to engage with or spread negativity
example: His philosophy was to avoid gossip entirely — see no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil.

word: Silence is golden
meaning_hi: चुप्पी सोने के समान है
meaning_en: it is often wiser to say nothing than to speak carelessly
example: He chose not to respond to the provocation; silence is golden.

word: Slow and steady wins the race
meaning_hi: धीरे और लगातार काम करने से सफलता मिलती है
meaning_en: consistent effort and patience ultimately lead to success
example: He revised his notes methodically for months and topped the examination — slow and steady wins the race.

word: Spare the rod and spoil the child
meaning_hi: बच्चे को अनुशासन न सिखाओ तो बिगड़ जाएगा
meaning_en: children need discipline to develop properly
example: The school's strict code of conduct was defended on the principle of spare the rod and spoil the child.

word: Speech is silver, silence is golden
meaning_hi: बोलना चाँदी है, चुप रहना सोना है
meaning_en: silence is often more valuable than speaking
example: He held his tongue during the dispute and earned more respect — speech is silver, silence is golden.

word: Still waters run deep
meaning_hi: शांत इंसान अक्सर गहरी सोच वाला होता है
meaning_en: a quiet person may have great depth of knowledge or feeling
example: She rarely spoke in meetings but her written analysis was the finest — still waters run deep.

word: Strike while the iron is hot
meaning_hi: सही समय पर कार्य करना चाहिए
meaning_en: take action at the right moment before the opportunity passes
example: When the investor showed interest, she presented her proposal the same day — strike while the iron is hot.

word: The devil finds work for idle hands
meaning_hi: खाली दिमाग शैतान का घर होता है
meaning_en: people who have nothing to do are more likely to get into trouble
example: Unemployed youth turned to petty crime — the devil finds work for idle hands.

word: The early bird catches the worm
meaning_hi: जल्दी उठने वाले को अवसर मिलता है
meaning_en: those who start early or act promptly gain an advantage
example: He reached the market before dawn and secured the best produce — the early bird catches the worm.

word: The end justifies the means
meaning_hi: लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने के लिए किसी भी तरीके को उचित ठहराना
meaning_en: the outcome of an action justifies the methods used to achieve it (often used critically)
example: The authoritarian leader justified censorship by arguing that the end justifies the means.

word: The grass is always greener on the other side
meaning_hi: दूसरे की स्थिति हमेशा बेहतर लगती है
meaning_en: other people's circumstances always seem more attractive than one's own
example: He envied his neighbour's job until he tried it himself — the grass is always greener on the other side.

word: The leopard cannot change its spots
meaning_hi: स्वभाव बदलना मुश्किल होता है
meaning_en: a person's fundamental nature cannot be changed
example: Despite his promises of reform, he returned to old habits — the leopard cannot change its spots.

word: The more, the merrier
meaning_hi: जितने अधिक, उतना अच्छा
meaning_en: a larger number of people makes things more enjoyable
example: He invited everyone on the floor to the celebration — the more, the merrier.

word: The pen is mightier than the sword
meaning_hi: कलम तलवार से अधिक शक्तिशाली है
meaning_en: writing and ideas have more lasting power than violence
example: The journalist's exposé ended the corrupt regime — the pen is mightier than the sword.

word: The proof of the pudding is in the eating
meaning_hi: किसी चीज़ की असली परख उसके उपयोग से होती है
meaning_en: the true value of something can only be judged by trying or using it
example: The new policy looked good on paper but the proof of the pudding is in the eating.

word: There is no smoke without fire
meaning_hi: जहाँ धुआँ हो वहाँ आग होती है
meaning_en: where there are rumours, there is usually some basis of truth
example: The persistent allegations against him turned out to be founded — there is no smoke without fire.

word: Think twice before you act
meaning_hi: काम करने से पहले दो बार सोचो
meaning_en: consider your actions carefully before proceeding
example: The director reviewed every clause of the contract twice — think twice before you act.

word: Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it
meaning_hi: जो इतिहास से नहीं सीखते वे उसे दोहराते हैं
meaning_en: ignorance of history leads to the same mistakes being made again
example: The same fiscal policies that triggered the 1991 crisis were being repeated — those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.

word: Time and tide wait for none
meaning_hi: समय किसी का इंतजार नहीं करता
meaning_en: time moves on regardless of anyone's circumstances
example: He wasted weeks in indecision and missed the application deadline — time and tide wait for none.

word: Time is money
meaning_hi: समय ही धन है
meaning_en: time is a valuable resource that should not be wasted
example: The consultant billed by the hour and kept every meeting strictly on schedule — time is money.

word: To err is human, to forgive divine
meaning_hi: गलती करना इंसानी है, माफ करना ईश्वरीय
meaning_en: making mistakes is natural; forgiving them is the highest virtue
example: He chose to forgive the colleague who had betrayed him — to err is human, to forgive divine.

word: Too many cooks spoil the broth
meaning_hi: बहुत अधिक लोग काम बिगाड़ देते हैं
meaning_en: too many people involved in a task can ruin it
example: The report was revised by twelve managers and became incoherent — too many cooks spoil the broth.

word: Too much of anything is good for nothing
meaning_hi: किसी भी चीज की अति हानिकारक होती है
meaning_en: excess of anything is harmful
example: He over-trained and injured himself before the championship — too much of anything is good for nothing.

word: Truth is stranger than fiction
meaning_hi: सच्चाई कल्पना से अधिक विचित्र होती है
meaning_en: real events are sometimes more surprising than anything imagined
example: The story of the lost twin brothers reuniting after sixty years proved that truth is stranger than fiction.

word: Two heads are better than one
meaning_hi: दो मस्तिष्क एक से बेहतर होते हैं
meaning_en: collaborating with another person improves the quality of decisions
example: The joint research produced breakthroughs that neither scientist could have achieved alone — two heads are better than one.

word: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown
meaning_hi: सत्ता में रहने वाले को चैन नहीं मिलता
meaning_en: those in positions of power or authority have many worries and cannot rest easily
example: The prime minister's sleepless nights amid the crisis showed that uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

word: Union is strength
meaning_hi: एकता में शक्ति है
meaning_en: people working together are more powerful than individuals acting alone
example: The small traders united and collectively negotiated better terms — union is strength.

word: United we stand, divided we fall
meaning_hi: एकता में शक्ति है, फूट में विनाश
meaning_en: unity gives strength while division leads to failure
example: When the workers presented their demands collectively, the management listened — united we stand, divided we fall.

word: Use it or lose it
meaning_hi: उपयोग करो नहीं तो खो दोगे
meaning_en: skills and abilities deteriorate if not practised regularly
example: Languages must be spoken regularly — use it or lose it.

word: Variety is the spice of life
meaning_hi: विविधता जीवन का आनंद है
meaning_en: having a wide range of experiences makes life enjoyable
example: He changed his reading genre every month — variety is the spice of life.

word: Virtue is its own reward
meaning_hi: नेकी का फल नेकी ही है
meaning_en: the act of being good is itself satisfying, without needing further reward
example: He donated anonymously; for him, virtue is its own reward.

word: Waste not, want not
meaning_hi: संसाधनों की बचत करने से कमी नहीं होती
meaning_en: if you use things carefully, you will always have enough
example: She repaired the torn jacket rather than discarding it — waste not, want not.

word: Well begun is half done
meaning_hi: अच्छी शुरुआत आधी सफलता है
meaning_en: a good start makes the rest of a task much easier
example: The detailed research plan made the whole project smoother — well begun is half done.

word: What cannot be cured must be endured
meaning_hi: जो बदला नहीं जा सकता उसे सहना पड़ता है
meaning_en: if a situation cannot be changed, one must accept it with patience
example: Caught in the delay, she made the most of her time — what cannot be cured must be endured.

word: When in Rome, do as the Romans do
meaning_hi: जहाँ जाओ वहाँ के रीति-रिवाज अपनाओ
meaning_en: adapt to the customs and culture of wherever you are
example: He learnt the local language and followed local customs — when in Rome, do as the Romans do.

word: When poverty comes in at the door, love flies out of the window
meaning_hi: जब घर में गरीबी आती है, प्रेम चला जाता है
meaning_en: financial hardship strains even loving relationships
example: After losing his business, the couple's quarrels multiplied — when poverty comes in at the door, love flies out of the window.

word: When the cat is away, the mice will play
meaning_hi: मालिक के जाने पर नौकर मस्त हो जाते हैं
meaning_en: people take liberties when the person in authority is absent
example: The staff arrived late in the manager's absence — when the cat is away, the mice will play.

word: Where there is a will, there is a way
meaning_hi: इच्छाशक्ति हो तो रास्ता मिल जाता है
meaning_en: determination always finds a solution to any difficulty
example: Despite losing both hands, he learned to paint with his feet — where there is a will, there is a way.

word: Wisdom is better than riches
meaning_hi: ज्ञान धन से बेहतर है
meaning_en: knowledge and good judgement are more valuable than money
example: The elderly advisor steered the company through crisis without spending a rupee — wisdom is better than riches.

word: With friends like these, who needs enemies
meaning_hi: ऐसे मित्रों से तो शत्रु भले
meaning_en: said of friends whose behaviour is as harmful as that of enemies
example: He lied to protect himself and implicated his friend — with friends like these, who needs enemies.

word: You can lead a horse to water, but you cannot make it drink
meaning_hi: तुम किसी को अवसर दे सकते हो, पर उसका उपयोग करना उस पर निर्भर है
meaning_en: you can give someone an opportunity but cannot force them to use it
example: The college provided every facility, but some students still did not study — you can lead a horse to water, but you cannot make it drink.

word: You cannot burn the candle at both ends
meaning_hi: एक साथ सभी दिशाओं में मेहनत नहीं हो सकती
meaning_en: you cannot sustain effort in too many directions without harming yourself
example: Juggling three jobs and post-graduate study, she eventually burned out — you cannot burn the candle at both ends.

word: Zeal without knowledge is fire without light
meaning_hi: ज्ञान के बिना उत्साह अंधकार में आग है
meaning_en: enthusiasm without proper understanding causes more harm than good
example: The overzealous policy was implemented without research and failed — zeal without knowledge is fire without light.

word: Don't bite the hand that feeds you.
meaning_en: One should not harm or be ungrateful to someone who supports or helps them.
meaning_hi: जो आपकी मदद करता है उसे नुकसान मत पहुँचाओ या उसके प्रति कृतघ्न मत बनो।
example: He insulted his own mentor who had got him the job — a classic case of biting the hand that feeds you.
options: One should not harm or be ungrateful to someone who supports or helps them.
One should always offer food before asking for a favour.
Animals can sense when they are in danger.
Helping others always comes with risks.

word: A man is known by the company he keeps.
meaning_en: A person's character is judged by the kind of people they associate with.
meaning_hi: व्यक्ति की पहचान उसके साथियों से होती है — संगति ही चरित्र का दर्पण होती है।
example: His parents warned him about his new friends, reminding him that a man is known by the company he keeps.
options: A person's character is judged by the kind of people they associate with.
A successful man is one who has many friends and business contacts.
One should keep records of all business partners.
The more friends a person has, the better their reputation.
